x.description: example array-like, used for shape and dtype information.

fill_value.description: a scalar value to fill the entries of the output array.

dtype.description: optional, a dtype parameter for the output ndarray.

shape.description: optional, a shape parameter for the output ndarray.

sharding.description: an optional sharding specification for the resulting array. If not specified, the output will have the same sharding as the input, with a few exceptions/limitations in particular: 1. Sharding is not available during tracing, thus this will rely on jit. 2. If x is weakly typed or uncommitted, will use default sharding. 3. Shape is not None and is different from x.shape, default will be used.

output.description: An ndarray with the same shape as `x` with its entries set equal to `fill_value`, similar to the output of np.full.
